༄༅/ /slob dpon bshad sgrub mtshan can gyi rnam thar rgyu skar rnam par rtsen pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /slob dpon bshad sgrub mtshan can gyi rnam thar rgyu skar rnam par rtsen pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na mo mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ thabs shes rlung gi shing rta ches drangs sgrib bral chos sku'i mkhar 'phags te/ /tshad med 'phrin las 'od stong rab 'phro log smra'i rgyu skar zil mnan cing*/ /gdul bya'i rmongs mun sel dang lhan cig dge legs padmo 'dzum mdzad pa/ /smra ba'i nyi ma shākya'i rgyal por dus rnams kun tu phyag bgyi'o/ /gdod ma nyid nas byang chub mchog brnyes spangs dang rtogs pa mthar phyin yang*/ /rgyal sras sa bcu'i dbang phyug zol bsten byang chub spyod pa'i mtshor rol zhing*/ /zab dang rgya che'i chos kyi char chen gdul bya'i zhing sar 'bebs mkhas pa/ /rgyal tshab mi pham 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhabs pad spyi bos rtag tu mchod/ /thub bstan rin chen ri bo'i rtse mor mang thos sa srung dbang po'i steng*/ /gzhung lugs sa chen khyon la lta ba'i spyan bgrad rnam dpyod rdo rje rtse brgya 'dzin/ /log rtog lha min dpung gi tshogs 'joms legs bshad bdud rtsi'i bum bzang mchog /sbyin mdzad shing rta chen po gnyis sogs 'dzam gling mkhas rnams rtag tu bsngags/ /mdo sngags gzhung brgya'i gangs ri'i spor gnas mang thos lus ngag stobs rtsal rdzogs/ /lung rigs mche sder rnon po rab 'bar phas rgol glang po'i klad 'gems shing*/ /rnam dpyod g.yu ral mchog gis rab mdzes zab don gad rgyangs sgrogs pa can/ /chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa khyod smra ba'i seṅge cis ma yin/ /mgon de'i mdo sngags dam pa'i chos kyi mdzod/ /ji bzhin bzung nas bstan dang 'gro ba la/ /phan mdzad rgyal tshab mkhas grub 'dul 'dzin sogs/ /brgyud 'dzin rim par byon la'ang gus phyag 'tshal/ khyad par bdag blo'i rin chen kā la shar/ /mdo rgyud dbang lung man ngag rig gnas sogs/ /legs bshad sgrub char 'bebs mdzad bka' drin can/ / yongs 'dzin rnams la gus pas phyag bgyi'o/ /tshur mthong mkhas rlom bdag lta bur/ /lo rgyus byis pa'i rol rtsed las/

/mkhas pa mgu ba bskyed nus pa'i/ /rnam thar nam mkha'i padmo bzhin/ /'on kyang ji ltar rnga bo che/ /daṇḍis bskul tshe dbang med par/ /rang las sgra ni 'byung ba ltar/ /dam pa'i gsung dbyung gis bsnun tshe/ /rang dbang gnas pa'i nus bral te/ /rnam dpyod dundhu bhi ngos su/ /lo rgyus ca co'i gtam zhig bsgrag/tshul 'di blo gros ldan rnams kyi/ /thos 'dzin rgyan du 'gyur dka' yang*/ /yid la gdung byed tsher ma ru/ /mi 'gyur bdag la sdig med mdzod/ /ces pas mdun bsus te skabs don brjod par bya ba la/ kho bo cag skyes pa'i yul ni mdo smad tho'u ju'i sa'i cha g.yo sa'am rab so yang zer ba co ne dpon gyi mnga' 'og tu gtogs shing*/ mkhas pa du ma byon pa'i gnas su yab bon po gzungs skyabs 'bum zhes bya ba yul der bon gyi rigs brgyud du gyur pa zhig ste/ 'bri 'don gnyis la mkhas par grags shing*/ bon dang gsang sngags rnying ma'i lugs dang*/ nag rtsis kyang dga' rab shes pa'o/ /yum ni skal bzang sman zhes bgyi ba yang tsho gsum zhes pa der bon dang sngags pa zung 'brel byed pa'i khyim du skyes shing*/ gzhon dus nas sgrol ma blor bzung ste kha ton rgyun du byed pa dang*/ gzhan gyis zur nas gdugs dkar sogs 'dzin cing 'don pa dag ni blo la thor bu 'ong ba'ang bdag gis mngon sum du gyur pa zhig ste/ gnyis ka'ang dad pa dang shes rab che zhing*/ rang dpag gi khyim pa pho mo 'dzoms pa de dus 'di gnyis las lhag pa sde pa der mi 'dug ces 'ga' zhig dang*/ bla ma sgom khrom pa nyid dngos su gsung ba thos so/ /de lta bu'i yab yum gnyis 'dus pa las shing yos zla ba dang po'i tshes brgyad kyi snga dro bdag gnod med du btsas pa yin zhes ma nyid zer ba lan 'ga' re thos/ /lo der yab kyis rgya nas tshad nad zhig khyer 'ong ba yum la 'gos te 'o ma ster ma thub pa'i rkyen gyis/

bdag 'chi la khad kyur pa'i tshe nged kyi a je rtswa mo tsho zhes pas thabs kyis gsos pas sos/ de nas bskyed bsrings nas lo lnga lon pa'i dus su rang gi khyim der dpe cha slob phyir 'ong ba'i grwa ba chang chung mang po snang ba dag gis dpe cha 'dzin skyor byed pa nyan pas 'ga' re blor zin cing*/ yi ge yang ma slob par thar thor shes pa byung zhes yab yum zer/ lo bdun song ba'i skabs su yi ge 'bri klog slob cing dpe 'dzin byas pas dka' tshegs med par shes pa byung ste/ lo dgu song ba'i phag lo'i bcu pa'i mchod ring skabs khri chen mkhan rin po che dge 'dun grags pa'i zhal snga nas kyi drung nas rab byung bsgrubs/ de nas lo bco lnga yan la kun rig /tshe dpag /'jigs byed/ chos skyong skor dang*/ sbyin bsreg /smon lam bstod tshogs skor dgon 'dir 'don pa rnams blor bzung zhing*/ bcu drug bcu bdun la gsang 'dus mngon dkyil dbang chog skor dang*/ sman bla rnams blor bzung*/ de nas phyis mtshan brjod dang*/ bde mchog gi mngon rtogs kyi tshal pa tsam blor bzung ste/ yab kyi blangs pa'i chos 'bri ba dang*/ rdzi 'o yang byed dgos byung bas dpe cha gzhan 'dzin pa cher ma byung*/ de nas rang gi yab kyis sngar gsos pa'i dge tshul dam chos dpal bzang zhes bya ba zhig mtsho kar song ba de/ sprel lo'i dgun thog yul du sleb pa na de la brten nas dbus la 'gro ba'i 'dun pas bya lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes bzhir mtsho khar song*/ de nas lo phyed gsum tsam la ni dbus su 'gro ba'i stabs ma 'grig pas/ der sbyin bdag ci rigs su chos 'don byed cing gnas pa dang*/ stag ris dge slong zhes bya ba'i sman pa mkhas pa zhig 'dug pa'i drung du sman dpe 'ga' zhing la bltas pas don rags rim zhig shes nas/ rtsa mdo chu mdo thor bu blor bzung ste nad pa 'ga' zhig gi rtsa yang lta dgos pa byung*/

sman sbyor shes pa tsam sla bar 'dug snyam yang*/ rtswa ni tsha grang spyi tsam shes kyang phug dka' bar mthong*/ de'i tshe kha cig dang dbus su'ang grogs 'ga' zhig gis khyed sman slob dang legs po shes par 'ong 'dug ces zer ba na nged kyis rtsed mo'i tshul gyis yin yang*/ pho mo gtsang mi gtsang du ma'i lag ngar nas 'dzin par mi 'dod kyi/ mgo la lag pa 'jog pa 'dod ces smras nas ma nyan no/ /der paṇa chen gong mas mdzad pa'i dge slong gi bslab bya tshigs bcad ma dang*/ mi la'i mgur 'bum par ma shog gu bzhi bcu'i skor zhig 'dug pa'i nang nas tshigs bcad gang yod pa blor bzung nas bton pa'i tshe nges 'byung ltar snang zhig skyes/ phag lo'i ston ka rgyu tshig dang 'grogs te dbus phyogs su phyin pas nag chu khar sleb pa'i tshe yam nad lta bu zhig gis grogs re gnyis shi zhing*/ rang nyid kyang na ba'i tshe 'di gnas 'di lta bu'i rang tshul du gyur na ma legs kyi/ dbus su phyin nas jo bo mjal te gzhan ci yang byed rgyu ma byung rung shi yang 'gyod pa med snyam du mi rtag pa'i tshul bcos ma min pa zhig dran/ bcu gcig pa'i tshes 'go la grwa sar sleb pa na nad kyang sos/ zla ba de'i nyi shu'i skor nas rgyan 'jug gnyis la brtson pa byas te bzung nas/ bcu gnyis pa'i nyi shu'i skor la rgyan 'jug gnyis ka blor bzung zin pas rang nyid ky-is rang 'dzin bzang snyam pa ma byung yang*/ /gzhan dag gis blo 'dzin bzang bar brjod gleng byed/ de nas byi ba lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes brgyad dgu nas ra mo cher grwa tshang gi chos grwar zhugs nas/ se rar 'ongs te rang 'dod kyis rgyu 'bras che ba'i dpe zhig mthong nas blo 'dzin byas pas cung 'dzin dka' bar byung ba na/ nged kyi rgan pa bkra shis dpal bzang zhes bya bas khyod kyis rgyan 'jug gnyis de tsam 'dzin sla bar byas pas/ 'di la dka' rgyu cang med kyang dka' dka' ltar byed pa ci zhig yin zhes zer te/

sngar bsdus dpe gzhan ma zung ba'i rkyen du snang*/ de nas chos thog tu rtsis gzhag 'dzin pa dang*/ dpe thog tu 'dzin pa zung 'brel byas nas bsdus dpe thar thor mang po bzung*/ khyad par du dpon slob btsan po pas mdzad pa'i bsdus dpe shog grangs bzhi bcu'i skor zhig snang ba de yongs rdzogs blo 'dzin byas te/ gzhung la gzhugs kyi bar du ma brjed par skyor byang byas pas blo bskyed che bar byung*/ de nas se rar chos thob gnyis gsum tsam song ba'i dbyar chos ra ba stod du song ste/ chos thog tu nyin re rtsis bzhag lan gnyis re gnang ba las/ lan rer yang rang gi 'dzin grwa'i skyor dpon byed pa'i zhor la 'dzin grwa gzhan gnyis kyi rtsis bzhag kyang blo la bzung nas skyor sbyang byas te ston chos gnyis gsum la'ang de ltar 'bad/ dgun ga 'jang gi dgun chos zla ba phyed gnyis yin pa'i thog tu song nas zla ba gcig gi ring la sngar ltar byas te 'dzin grwa lnga lnga'i rtsis bzhag dus gcig tu bzung bas/ ha cang skyor rgyu mang bas zla ba phyed la dus gcig tu rtsis bzhag gsum gsum blo la bzung*/ de'i tshe rtsis bzhag kyang nyi ma rer gtong thang gnyis re ma chags par byung ste/ ra ba stod pa'i chos 'chad nyan 'phel dus ni chos thog de yin par byed/ de'i mjug tu da ni bsdus grwa bzang po shes so snyam pa'i rlom pa zhig kyang byung*/ de'i tshe rtags rigs blo rigs kyang ci ltar rigs par blo la bzung yang 'di la rtsod pa de tsam ma byas pa ma gtogs/ gzhan se ra nas 'ong ba'i grwa pa rnams kyi nang nas rang nyid bsdus grwa bzang khul byas te/ sngon gyi bag chags lta bur mthong*/ de nas lo de nyid kyi phyi rol dpyid ka ra ba stod du song nas rtsis bzhag 'dzin skyong sogs la brtson pa drag tu 'bad/ da ni bsdus grwa legs por shes pas gzhung dpe 'dzin ran snyam pa skyes/ mdor na de dag gi skabs su nam phyed nye ba tsam du bsdad nas dpe cha skyor zhing sku rim kyang byas te brtson 'grus drag pos dpe cha 'dzin skyor ma gtogs/

bza' btung byed pa la'ang dpe cha 'gog pa'i 'du shes byung*/ de'i tshe bsdus dpe blo 'don byed rgyu yod pa bris na shog grangs nyis brgya sum brgya'i skor 'byung bar sems/ de nas zla ba gnyis pa'i nang du gzhung la ma zhugs kyang phar phyin gyi dbu nas nyin re shog gu gnyis re blo 'dzin byed par blos bcad de byas/ zla ba bzhi pa'i mjug tu gzhung la 'jug dus phar phyin gyi skabs dang po'i mtha' dpyod la shog grangs brgya dang bcu skor zhig snang ba yang tshar la khad byas te 'ga' zhig lo rgyus yod/ gzhung la 'jug pa'i skabs su grwa tshang du bsdus grwa'i dam bca' yang bzhag cing*/ gzhung la zhugs nas kyang bsdus grwa blo la skyor rgyu yod pa'i nang nas yul yul can sogs che ba'i skor rnams re zhig bar du ma brjed par byas pas/ gzhung la zhugs nas rim gy-is de rnams kyi don go ba byung*/ mdor na bsdus grwa la lo phyed dang gnyis tsam song yang da lta 'di ka'i bsdus grwa la lo bcu skor bsdad pa 'di dag las lhag go zhing*/ der ma zad de dus se rar yang bsdus grwar lo 'ga' re song ba'i bsdus grwa ba dag kyang dpa' skong bar byas te rang bstod tsam min par de dus kyi rang dang lhan cig brgal brtag byed pa dag gis shes/ de nas gzhung la zhugs nas chos thog gi skabs ma gtogs nyi ma rer snga dro yan gzhung dpe sho gu gnyis gsum sogs ci ltar rigs pa blo 'dzin byas nas phyi dro 'dzin thub kyang ma bzung ste skyor/ rtsis bzhag gi 'dzin grwa skabs dang po'i mjug tu yod pa'i tshe phar phyin gyi mtha' gcod yongs rdzogs zur bkol bzhi dang bcas pa blor bzung zin/ de'i tshe grwa khang rgyag pa'i dus yin pas rtsis bzhag thod brgal du byas nas gtong bar mdzad/ de nas lo gcig gnyis la dbu ma ma bzung bar sa lam rnam gzhag gi dpe cha zhig dang*/ paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa'i skabs dang po'i ṭīkka gnyis rdzogs par bzung zhing*/

'grel pa don gsal gyi skabs bzhi pa yan chad dang*/ /phar phyin gyi spyi don thar thor dang*/ rnam bshad snying po rgyan nas shog grangs sum cu'i skor dang*/ lam rim chen mo dang*/ drang nges rnam 'byed dang*/ de'i dka' 'grel rnams kyi stod nas sho gu bcu nyi shu'i skor tsam re bzung nas bzhag /bar bar du chos zhu ba dang*/ sa ris/ lañtsa/ hor yig /dag yig /sum rtags/ snyan ngag /nag rtsis/ dbyangs can sgra mdo rnams ci ltar rigs par slob/ chos grwar zhugs pa'i lo drug pa'i thog dpe mtshams su song nas dbu ma'i mtha' dpyod blo 'dzin byas/ de'i tshe gzhan dang 'dzin bzang ngan sad pas nyin gcig la dbu ma'i mtha' gcod mda' tshad ma thig pa shar dgu re yod pa zhig sho gu drug zin pas grogs po ha las/ phar phyin zur bkol dang bcas pa yongs rdzogs dang dbu phar gnyis sbrel nas lo kha shas skyor sbyar byas/ lo bdun pa'i tshe dbu ma'i spyi don blo 'dzin byas pas 'di nang du don tshang 'dug pas mtha' gcod zur du 'dzin ma dgos par 'dug snyam du sems pa'i 'gyod ngan skyes/ brgyad pa'i thog lo gcig po de'i nang du mdzod rtsa dang 'dul ba yongs rdzogs 'dzin pa dang*/ sgrol ma dang*/ rnam par rgyal ma'i gzungs khri khrag re 'don pa'i dam bca' phul nas de bzhin bsgrubs pas dka' tsam byung yang grub/ dgu pa'i nang du lnga pa chen po'i mdzod kyi yig cha blo la bzung*/ nyin re nan tan byas te bzung na ci tsam zin bltas pas sho gu dgu zin/ lo bcu song ba'i bya lo'i zla ba dang po'i nang du slob dpon rin po che tshul khrims dar rgyas zhal snga nas kyis khyi lo'i zla ba dang por lha sa'i smon lam chen mo'i thog tu ming gdags byed dgos pa'i bka' babs byung ba ltar khas blangs/ spyir grwa tshang nas ming gdags ster ba'i thog mar se ra'i dka' bcu mdzad de/ phyis smon lam ming bdags 'os pa zhig yod na de ster ba'i srol yod kyang*/

nged la ni bla mas khyed kyis dka' bcu'i mtshan gdags zur du byed dgos par mi snang bas smon lam grwa skor byas nas dka' bcu'i dod tsam du bshad pa dag dam bca' bzhag chog ces gsungs nas gnang*/ sngar grwa tshang du ming gdags ma byas par smon lam du ming gdags byas pa re gnyis byung 'dug zer yang nged 'dug pa'i ring la rang ma gtogs grwa tshang gi grwa pa'i nang nas smon lam ming gdags dang dka' bcu stabs gcig byed pa nged tsam yin zhing*/ de nas nga'i tshab tu de ltar byed pa zhig kyang byung ngo*/ /de yang gtso bo rang gis dpe cha bzang po byas pa'i mthu yin gyis/ /bla ma la'ang 'jig rten gyi ngo srung lta bu'i mdzes mdzes byas pa med mod/ 'on kyang bla ma thugs ma mnyes na skyon du 'gyur pa'ang mthong*/ bla ma'i thugs zin pa gzhan med kyang se ra'i tshogs chen du bka' bstan bcos dang*/ skabs bzhi pa dang*/ brgyad pa dang*/ rten 'brel dang*/ dbu ma'i thal bzlog dang*/ 'dul ba'i dus tshigs dang*/ gso sbyong rnams kyis tshogs langs byas pa'i tshe bshad pa dang sgro gleng gang byas kyang bzang ngos shes pa re 'os pa la slob dpon la thugs mnyes zhes grags la/ khyad par 'dul ba'i gso sbyong la tshogs langs byed pa'i tshe bla ma bzhugs pas shin tu dgyes pa 'dug ces gleng*/ de ltar na'ang khyi lor smon lam du ming gdags byed rtsis yod pa las/ bya lo'i nang du bstan pa'i gegs chags su 'khrugs pa byung nas dbyar dus su sde srid rin po che sku zhi bar gshegs/ /de'i dgongs rdzogs la dmigs nas brgyad pa'i nang du dge rtsa gtong ba'i tshe/ gtsang phyogs ma gtogs dbus phyogs kyi grub mtha' gcig mi gcig gi 'dus sde'i rigs thams cad lha sar bsdus nas/ khri tsho gnyis gsum tsam lha sa'i smon lam chen mo ltar byas te tshogs/ /de tshogs pa la zhag bcu skor tsam yod pa'i tshe gzhung nas bka' bab ste/

ming gdags byed mkhan yang smon lam ltar dgos zhes gnang*/ de'i tshe bla mas nga gzim khang du bos te khyod kyis dge rtsa chen mo byed pa 'di thog tu smon lam ming gdags gyis zhes gsungs/ nged kyis lags/ snga ma gnang ba ltar khyi lor lha sa nas byed kyi/ da res mi nus zhes nan cher zhus pas/ khyed kyis dpe cha rnams song 'dug pas mi nus pa ga la 'ongs/ /der ma zad smon lam spyir grags che yang*/ da res de las lhag tu dge 'dun gyi sde bzhi 'gyur lnga 'gyur gyi che zhing*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bzang bzang thams cad da res 'byon/ 'gyed kyang da res lhag /lha sa'i smon lam chen mo yongs grags la gang 'tshang ka rgyag nus pa dang dar gzhon kha yar mang po las rgan pa dang bzang po mang du mi tshogs/ da res ni de thams cad tshogs rgyu yin 'dug pas dga' zhes gsungs yang*/ slar yang ngas gzhan ster 'os pa de 'dra yod 'gro bas de la byin/ da res ngas mi nus byas pas yod na khyod kyis nged la drongs byin zhes gsungs shing*/ thugs rgyal bzhengs grab byas te khyed rang 'dri sa yod na dris zhes gsungs te bzhugs/ lags zhes zhus nas 'ongs te grogs mched 'ga' zhig la smras pas/ bla ma'i bka' bcag na mi rung 'dug pas khas longs zhes zer ba ltar/ slar bla ma'i drung du song ste de ltar bgyid lags zhes zhus pas bla ma thugs shin tu dgyes dgyes ltar mdzad/ bshad pa bgos pas rnam 'grel gyi le'u gnyis pa babs pa ltar blor bzung ste lha sa'i khyams grwar dge 'dun gy-i sde rgya mtsho lta bu'i nang du sgra dag gsal gsum gyi sgo nas bshad pa legs par rgyab/ rang skal gyi dam bca' bzhag pas dga' rab byung bas der gnas pa'i slob dpon pa dag mgu nas sman ram pa'i dam bca' skal pa'ang nga la gnang byung bas bzhag /sgro gleng gtong mkhan gang bzang bzang rnams byung yang lan zhum pa med par btab/ tshogs su gdong grwal gyi 'gor nged ming gdags pa rnams bsdad chog pa byung zhing*/

'gyed kyi skal pa sogs nyis 'gyur du gnang ngo*/ /ming gdags thon nas slar se rar 'ong ba na bla mas pos ta da res bzang byung zhes gsungs nas/ dbon po la rab 'byams par stod 'gag zhig dang zhwa ser gcig byin ces bka' dngos su gnang byung yang dbon pos ske rags zhig las ma byung ste/ bla ma'i bdag rkyen la dga' byung*/ de nas lo de'i dgu pa'i nang du grwa tshang du mang ja bkol te bla mar 'dul ba'i rnam grangs tsam byas/ bshad pa rgyab ste dam bca' bzhag pas/ nyi ma sngon ma'i gung yol nas phyi ma'i dros chen bar thams cad kyis sgro gleng btang byung ba la lan legs par btab/ spyir sngar ming gdags byed man mkhas pa su zhig yin kyang sgro gleng gi tshe dam bca' shor ba'am ma shor yang sgrub byed tsam dang*/ nyis 'dzin byas chog par yang 'khor gsum byed pas dam bca' ba la 'khor gsum 'ga' re mi phog pa gtan ma byung zhing*/ 'on kyang a mo tshang chos 'byor rab 'byams pa'i tsha bo ming gdags byed dus su bla ma'i zhal nas 'di bdag rkyen yin pas 'khor gsum gtan byed mi nyan/ byas na nged kyis de tshar gcod rgyu yin zhes gsungs te dam bca'i skabs su bzhugs pas su gang gis kyang 'khor gsum byed ma nus mod/ nged la de lta bu la ma ltos par dam bca'i skabs grwa tshang gi rgan gzhon thams cad kyis mthong bzos chen po mdzad nas 'khor gsum byed mkhan gcig kyang ma byung ste/ 'khor gsum la nges pa ci yod kyang rang la bdag rkyen du 'dug pas brjod/ de nas rdo chas su bshad pa yang rgyab ste dam bca' bzhag go /de'i phyi lo gtsang du song nas bsnyen rdzogs bsgrubs/ slar 'ongs nas khyi lo de'i ston ka rgyud grwar zhugs nas dam bca' lan gsum bzhag /dgun dus rgyud pa rnams dga' ldan du byon pa'i tshe dga' ldan du'ang dam bca' zhig bzhag /phag lo'i zla ba dang por rgyud stod pa rnams 'bras spungs su byon nas zhag cha shas bzhugs pa'i tshe 'bras spungs su dam bca' bzhag pa'i dus su/

sgo mang nas sgro gleng gtong mkhan rig pa can mang po byung bas ngo mtshar che ba byung zhing*/ dam bca' de rnams kyi tshe lan dga' rab byung yang rang gis rang mi bstod/ skabs der thig rtsa'i skor 'ga' re yang 'khrid/ de nas skyor mo lung du rgyud la song ste dam bca' 'jog rtsis byas kyang*/ sngar se rar grogs mched zhig la nged 'khrid mkhan byung na yul du log 'gro bas e 'dug ltos zhes lan bzhag pa de'i lan du 'gro na 'khrid mkhan snang zhes zer ba la brten nas/ se rar phyir song ste yul du 'gro ba'i grabs byas rkyen yang da dung lo gnyis gsum tsam la chos kha zhu rgyu 'ga' zhig zhu ba'i ched du rgyud du 'gro snyam pa yod kyang*/ khang tshan dge rgan byed pa'i dus la bab 'dug pas de las g.yol na rang yul du 'gro ba ma gtogs/ gzhan gang du phyin yang dge rgan byed dgos pa'i 'ba' yig yod pas/ dge rgan byed 'dod gtan med kyang zlog thabs gzhan ma byung bas yul du 'gro ba'i bsam pa shar/ de'i tshe rgyud stod pa'i bla ma slob dpon mkhas pa chen po khri chen blo bzang dar rgyas pa la dgongs pa zhus pa na yul du ma 'gro/ phyogs 'dir bsdad na bla chen 'ong zhes gsungs byung yang*/ nged kyis sgo la rgyab na bla ma yin pas 'di ka'i bla ma'i a nyan mgo dkar gyi dpe ltar 'gro bas mi dgos zhes sku rtses zhus nas ma nyan pas gnang*/ se ra na yod pa'i tshe ming gdags ma byas gong dang ming gdags byas zin nas kyang rang gi grogs po 'ga' zhig gis khyed rtsis bzhag gnang bar zhu zhes zer te nan che yang yul du 'ong 'dod nas khas ma blangs/ dbus nas chos kha ji ltar zhus tshul 'og tu lhan cig 'chad par bya'o/ /se rar bsdad pa'i dus su mthun rkyen phran tshogs bsgrub pa'i ched du lha sar song nas nyo rgyug yin pa de rgyal pham gang byung yang nyos te jo bo rin po che la bskor ba dang*/

drung du song ste phyag mchod smon lam re byas nas dgon du yong ba ma gtogs/ gzhan 'ga' zhig ltar gnas tshang du 'gro ba sogs ma byas pas nyes chung pa yod/ de nas dge slong blo gros rgya mtshos tshong pa dge 'dun dar rgyas la bskul ba ltar khal rta sogs khong rang dang du blangs te phag lo'i dpyid tshong pa dang 'grogs nas bzhi pa'i bco lngar mtsho khar sleb/ sngar gyi nged kyi dge tshul de la chas kha cang mi 'dug pa thos kyang*/ khong la brten nas dbus su song ba yin pas drin bzo ba'i phyir de'i rtsar song nas zla ba drug tsam la grong chog 'ga' re byung ba'i yon bsags te khal rta nyos nas bcu pa'i nang du gnyis ka rang yul du sleb/ de nas pha ma gnyis dang 'phrad kyang lo phyi ma la pha tshe'i dus byas pas dge rtsa btang*/ de nas zur du grong chog byas chog pa'i ri khrod pa zhig bya snyam yang mas las sna ma drangs par du ma 'gro/ de nas thag nye 'dir ri khrod byas nas sdod ces nan ches pa ltar khas blangs nas sbrul lo'i bcu pa'i nang du co ne dgon du rang skal gyi las sna drangs te gzhan phan gyi bsam pas sangs rgyas du ma'i mtshan bsgrigs zhig brkos te par du btab nas dge 'dun thams cad la phul zhing 'gyed mar khu dang bcas byas/ rgya nang du 'gro bsam pa med kyang grogs po 'ga' zhig gis lo gnyis gsum gyi bar la rgya nang du song na legs pa'i bskul ma nan tan du byas pa'i tshe ma la don de brjod pas gtan ma 'gro zhes tshig nan che bas 'gro ba bkag go /de nas rta lo'i dpyid ka ri khraud lta bu'i khang pa zhig bya ba'i 'dun pa btang nas yod pa las/ ༈ co ne'i bstan pa'i mnga' bdag ko'u shrī nang so yes nyid pho brang du gong ma rgyal po mjal phyin pa'i tshe/ rgyal po dang bla chen du mas yes la khyod kyis rang dgon der mtshan nyid kyi bshad grwa zhig tshugs zhes gnang ba ltar zhal gyis bzhes te yul du byon nas/

shing rta sa ga zla ba'i tshes bdun la mtshan nyid grwa tshang 'dzug pa'i dus su nged la grwa tshang bla ma bya dgos par bka' babs pa'i tshe/ rmi ltas bzang po zhig byung bas dgongs pa yang ma zhus par khas blangs/ sa ga zla ba'i tshes drug gi nyin dgon du 'ong ba'i skabs su rten 'brel brtags pas/ thog ma sgor thon pa'i tshe rten 'brel bzang zhing*/ lhag tu 'dir sleb pa'i tshe sgo mo che'i nang du chu zo gnyis dang lhan cig 'grogs nas 'gro ba'i rten 'brel 'grig byung bas legs po 'ong ba 'dra snyam pa byung*/ der ma zad tshes bdun gyi nyin chos grwar 'gro ba'i thog mar rten 'brel brtags pa na de yang legs pa zhig byung*/ de nas rtsis bzhag nyi ma re la re gnang ste/ lo ngo gsum du bsdus grwa'i rtsis bzhag 'dzin grwa thog ma la btang ba tsam bris pas shog grangs brgya dang lnga bcu'i skor byung ba da lta bla ma gzhan 'ga' zhig gis rtsis bzhag de thog nas mdzad 'dug /lug gi lor ma nyid dus las 'das pa'i dge rtsa btang*/ sngar rang nyid kyis bsdus grwa skyor sbyang mang po byas shing don yang legs par go ba'i mthus de'i bar bsdus grwa'i tshig don rnams yid la bis pa ltar snang bas dpe gzhan la rag ma las shing*/ phyis ni dbus nas rkyang bsdus dpe zhig bris nas bskur byung*/ der ma zad/ da dung yang zar zur 'ga' re ma gtogs bsdus grwa'i gnad rnams ma brjed par snang zhing don lhag par go 'dug kha cig bsdus grwa'i rigs pa rnams rang la blo rtse gtad mtshams legs po med pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas nged kyang de lta bu'i snyam du thog mar sems kyang phyis kyi blo gtad yod med shes song*/ de nas lo gsum pa la gzhung btsugs te phar phyin gyi dbu nas rtsis bzhag rim gyis btang bas skabs lnga par sleb pa'i tshe glang gi lo la yes kyi bkas khri byed pa dang mtshan nyid kyi chos 'chad pa gnyis zung 'brel gyis skyong dgos zhes bka' babs pa na rmi ltas bzang ngan 'dres ma zhig byung yang skyon med snyam nas thom thom du byed par khas blangs te byas/

lo der 'brum bu'i yams nad zhig dkon par byung ste 'ga' re shi/ nged la tsha bo bande chos gar zhugs pa 'dzin shes rab sogs nged las lhag pa 'ong du re ba zhig yod pa de 'brum pa byung nas dus byas pas sems khral chen po byung*/ de'i rkyen gyis nged kyang nad kyis zin pa na/ ko'u shrī yes kyis thugs khur bzhengs nas sman pa bos te gso ba dang rim gro yang mang du byas pas rim gyis bde bar song yang*/ bande de dang bral ba'i rkyen gyis gzim khang du 'dug gtan nas mi 'dod pa dper na btson khang nas thar 'dod lta bu zhig byung yang bsdad/ stag gi lor nad skyon cher mi 'dug kyang rang la 'dod pa med pas yes la dgongs pa zhus pa na 'gyod bzhin du gnang bas dga' spro dpag med byung*/ khri byed dus su yi dam sgrub skor de dang dag yig che chung gnyis sogs 'ga' zhig brtsams nas par du brkos pas par brkos kyi thog ma yin/ grwa tshang slob dpon pa byed dus dbu phar gnyis kyi yig cha sogs 'ga' re brtsams te gangs 'og tu lhan cig 'chad/ dgongs pa zhus te rang gi khang par sleb nas lo re gnyis la lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum sogs brtsams te par du brkos/ de nas rang yul der ri khrod lta bu zhig bya ba'i khang pa zur du btab ste re zhig la phar 'gro tshur 'gro dang phyis rgyun du 'dug rgyu e 'ong snyam nas khang pa byas pa der lo gsum tsam gyi ring dbyar dus su zla ba re bsdad kyang don med du mi 'ga' re 'ongs nas 'phros gleng gis dge sbyong chags shing*/ mthun rkyen ma 'dzom pas bza' btung tsam yang thad kar byed mi thub pa dang*/ nye du dang thag nye bar go rgyu dang thos rgyu mang po rna bar 'ong ba'i rkyen gyis der sdod mi 'dod pa byung ste/ lug lo'i nang du nang so yes kyis/ slar khri thog tu 'ong dgos pa'i bka' nan ches pas zlog ma thub pa na byed par khas blangs/

de'i tshe rmi lam gyi ltas shin tu legs pa 'ga' re byung bas skyon med pa 'dra snyam du sems/ khri byas pa'i lo gsum pa bya lo la bstan pa'i mnga' bdag ko'u shrī yes kyis rgyud pa grwa tshang gsar btsugs kyi slob dpon pa byed dgos pa'i bka' gnang ba ltar khas blangs pa'i tshe rmi ltas legs pa 'ga' re byung*/ de gong mtshan nyid kyi 'chad nyan gyi slob dpon pa yang yin pa la/ de gzhan la byed du bcug ste kho bo nyid kyis rgyud pa'i bla ma dang mkhan po zung 'brel byas nas rgyud pa sogs grwa pa mang po la bde gsang gnyis kyi dbang bskur ba sogs byas/ khri byed bzhin par gsang bde 'jigs gsum gy-i bskyed rdzogs sogs mang du brtsams te bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi 'chad nyan dang 'grel pa bzhi sbrags kyi bshad pa sogs byas pas rgyud pa grwa tshang nas mtshan gdags kyang thon/ de'i tshe rgyud pa grwa tshang dgon 'dir ma zad gong so dgon dang nags mdo dang thur tshang dang yes nyid bzhugs pa'i gnas rnams su byon te rgyud pa'i 'chad nyan dang rtsom pa sogs yar ngo'i zla ba ltar 'phel ba na 'ga' zhig ma dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan byung yang*/ rang ngos nas nyes pa byas pa ci yang med pas 'phral du sems la gnod tsam las ma byung*/ de ltar lo kha shas song ba na bya ba rnams legs par 'grub ste mthar dgongs pa zhus pas gnang byung bas dga'/ de nas bla ma gzhan zhig khri thog tu bskos te rgyud pa'i 'chad nyan gyi slob dpon byed du bcugs kyang tshes ma chog pa na slar nged rgyud pa'i slob dpon pa byed dgos byung ste/ de'i tshe 'grel pa bzhi sbrags kyi bshad pa rdzogs par byas shing gsang ba de gnyis kyi rtsa rgyud la 'grel pa re dang lhan thabs sogs mang du brtsams/ dgon pa la brten nas byung ba'i dngos po dang yes kyis gnang sbyin byas pa phal cher dgon pa'i zhabs tog tu btang zhing*/ 'ga' zhig ni dge slong dbus su 'gro skabs ser 'bras dge gsum bkra shis lhun po rnams su mang ja dang grwa tshang la 'gyed/

sku zhabs dang paṇa chen sogs la 'bul ba'i ched du bskur ro// //da ni de dag gi skabs su chos ji ltar zhus pa ni/ dbus na yod dus su slob dpon sems dpa' chen po paṇḍi ta'i sku zhabs nas gsang 'dus/ 'jigs byed/ kun rig /tshe dpag /rta mgrin/ khros ma nag mo'i dbang la sogs pa dbang bka' ci rigs dang*/ gsang bde 'jigs gsum sogs kyi mngon dkyil skor dang*/ mdo sde brgyad brgya pa/ rtogs bdun/ khrid chen brgyad sogs gzhan du ma'i lung byung zhing*/ mgon po dang*/ rnam sras/ mang po'i rjes gnang dang*/ khyad par du 'jam dpal zhal lung nas skyes bu 'bring yan gyi 'khrid rgyun blo 'dzin gyi tshul du thob cing*/ skyes bu chen po'i skor la de ltar byed pa ma byung yang 'khrid rgyun zhus shing*/ 'jigs byed kyi bskyed rim bsre brgyud pa'i 'khrid rgyun gyi dpe cha blo 'dzin gyi tshul du thob/ rdzogs rim gyi stod cha de ltar byas kyang smad lung 'khrid tsam byas/ khri rin po che blo bzang dar rgyas sku zhabs nas gsang 'dus bskyed rim gyi 'khrid rgyun rdzogs par zhus shing*/ rdzogs rim ni skabs gzhan du thor bur byas te gsungs pa thob la/ lcags mkhar zur dgu pa'i skor dang*/ chos spyod/ yi dam sgrub skor chung ba/ sku zhabs rin po che'i gtor ma sna tshogs sogs thob/ gzhan 'ga' zhus kyang brjed 'dug /paṇa chen rgyal dbang snga phyi gnyis sde srid rin po che sogs 'ga' la'ang chos 'brel zhus/ rgyud pa dbu mdzad par lcags mkhar zur bcu drug pa'i skor zhus/ a ra rab 'byams par lam rim gyi 'khrid sogs 'ga' re dang*/ grub khang dpon slob la rigs gsum mgon po sogs kyi rjes gnang dang lung thar thor 'ga' re zhus shing*/ mnga' ris sprul skur mtshan brjod dang*/ bla ma mchod pa sogs 'ga' re'i lung zhus/ grwa tshang dpon slob kyi drung nas lam rim gyi lung lan 'ga' re thob ste mjug ma rdzogs/

yul 'dir sngon rje drung rin po ches lam rim chen mo'i lung gnang ba'i tshe don go rgyu ma byung yang lung ma chags par nyan/ slob dpon bzang po rgyal mtshan par lam rim chen mo'i lung*/ yi dam sgrub skor che ba'i lung sogs 'ga' zhig nyan yang la la brjed song snang*/ / stong 'khor zhabs drung nas 'jam dpal zhal lung dang*/ rong phug slob dpon byang chub mi la tshang gi drung du paṇa chen gong ma'i gsung 'bum yongs rdzogs/ sdud pa dang gcod pa/ mngon rtogs rgyan/ spyod 'jug /dbu ma rigs tshogs drug sogs 'ga' re'i lung nyan/ mkhas grub ngag dbang brtson 'grus pa'i drung nas/ bde mchog lha lnga dang*/ 'jigs byed dpa' gcig /dus 'khor dbang mdor bstan/ rgyal dbang lnga pa'i lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum gyi 'grel pa/ dbyangs can ma dang*/ mi 'khrugs pa'i rjes gnang sogs 'ga' re zhus/ yul 'dir slob dpon blo bzang sbyin pa'i drung nas sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang dang*/ chos skyong skor gyi rjes gnang dang*/ klu dbang gi rgyal po'i rjes gnang sogs 'ga' re dang*/ bcu gcig zhal gyi dbang dang*/ tshe dbang*/ rta mgrin gnyis sbrel ba'i rjes gnang dbus phyogs nas kyang lan 'ga' re dang*/ 'dir byon nas kyang lan kha yar thob cing*/ rjes gnang gzhan mang po dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag 'ga' re yang thob pas bdag la chos kyi sgo nas bka' drin che/ dbus su gzhan dag gis 'di pa'i drung du lung 'khrid sogs zhus pa'i zhor la nyan pa 'ga' yod kyang sngon de'i dus su yi ger ma bkod cing*/ phyis dran pa rnams yi ger bkod pa yang sbyin sreg byas 'dug /slob dpon rdo rje 'chang chen po blo gros rgya mtsho'i sku zhabs nas bde mchog lū he pa dang*/ gsang 'dus/ kun rig gsum gyi dbang*/ bde gsang gnyis kyi rtsa rgyud kyi lung*/ 'grel pa bzhi sbrags kyi lung rgyun/ bde mchog rgyud 'grel/

sngags rim/ gsang bde gnyis kyi bskyed rdzogs kyi lung 'khrid/ 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs kyi lung rgyun dang*/ lung dang rjes gnang gzhan re gnyis zhus shing*/ gsang bde gnyis la khong bka' drin lhag par che/ gzhan yang*/ dbus nas yul du 'ongs pa na rang dgar ma bsdad par bka' 'gyur tshar gcig bsgrags/ rang gis dbus nas dpe cha dum pa bcu drug tsam khyer 'ong ba rnams la yang yang bltas pas don go rgyu sngar las lhag tu song zhing*/ khyad par du grwa tshang gi bla ma byed dus sogs su dbu phar 'dul mdzod rnam 'grel ṭīka chen sogs dang*/ rtsa she'i 'grel ba sogs dpe chen du ma dang*/ bka' 'gyur dang*/ bstan 'gyur dang*/ rje'i gsung 'bum gyi nang nas lta 'dod pa rnams la yang yang bltas pas blo gros yar ngo'i zla ba lhar 'phel/ de dag las rtsa she'i ṭīkka chen mo dang*/ rnam 'grel ṭīka chen gnyis la dbus na yod pa'i dus su 'ga' re bltas pas don sum cha tsam zhig las go rgyu ma byung yang*/ 'dir 'du khang thog sogs nas lan mang du bltas pa'i mthus/ da lta bltas na mig bye ba ltar snang*/ skabs zhig tu 'di gnyis kyi don rdzogs par rtogs dka' mod 'di ltar go btsal yang dbus gtsang du cung dkon zhing*/ phyogs 'dir ni kho bo tsam mo snyam du khengs pa yang skyes/ 'on kyang rgya mtsho lta bu'i gzhung don mthong nas dga' skrag zhum pa rnams phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin du gyur/ de lta bu ni bdag gi rnam thar gyi mchog tu byas kyang rung ste/ mkhas pa mgu ba'i gnas ni 'di yin pas so/ kho bo cag gis ni tshad ma'i skor gyi yig cha thar thor mang du mthong zhing bltas kyang sde bdun yid kyi mun sel rang phan che ba byung*/ gzhan yang gzim khang du yod pa'i tshe dpe cha phan thogs su 'gyur nges gang rtsom pa'i tshe/ rmi ltas bzang po re nges par 'ong zhing phyis kyang de bzhin du 'ong*/ de lta bu'i tshe rmi ltas bzang po 'ga' byung ba de 'dir mi 'bri ste/

mi chos bla ma'i brdzun du smra ba'i sgro skur bya bar dogs so/ /'on kyang mtshon tsam skabs zhig tu 'phags pa nā gā rdzu nas byin gyis rlob pa'i mtshan ma nges par yin nam snyam pa'i rmi ltas khyad par can gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig byung nas shin tu dga' yang*/ rmi lam du mi rmi ba ci yang med pas de tsam yid ches ma byas/ rmi lam bzang po 'ga' zhig dad can re gnyis la bshad pas de'i rkyen yin nam/ yang na dam tshig lta bu zhig la sel byung ngam snyam ste/ de gzhan la smras pa de nas lo ngo gnyis gsum tsam la rmi lam bzang po de dag gtan nas ma byung bas ma legs par shes/ des na rmi lam bzang po byung na'ang bshad rgyu min 'dug go /gzhan yang*/ yes kyis dbu ma sogs 'ga' zhig par du brkos shing*/ dbu phar gnyis kyi dpe sogs 'ga' zhig ni dgon 'di nas dbus su song ba'i nged rang gi slob ma dad pa can dka' bcu byams pa dpal bzang gis thugs bskyed bzang pos dbus su bskur zhes bskul ba ltar de phyogs su phul bas/ dka' bcu khu tshan gnyis kyis nged kyis dpe cha bskur ba rnams gzhan la phan pa'i 'phrin las sgrub grogs byas shing*/ phyis 'dul mdzod kyi yig cha gnyis kyang brtsams te bskur ro/ /des na yes nyid dang*/ khong rnam gnyis kyis kyang nged kyis rtsom pa'i dka' las byas pa don ldan du mdzad pa yin/ bya ba gzhan sku gsung thugs kyi rten 'ga' zhig bzhengs nas yul gyi mchod khang du bzhag cing*/ gzhan la phan ched sku 'dra bcu skor par du brkos pa rnams dang*/ rtsom dpe par brkos rnams rang gnas pa'i khang par bzung*/ rtsom dpe par du brkos ma brkos gnyis kyi grangs ni 'di lta ste/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyi tshig 'grel mtha' gcod/ /de'i spyi don/ zur bkol bzhi/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyi ṭī ka rkyang*/ dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab kyi ṭīkka/ dbu ma 'jug pa'i tshig 'grel mtha' gcod/

/nyams len/ thog mar 'dzin chos su btang ba'i bsdus dpe yongs rdzogs/ tshad ma'i lo rgyus sa bcad dang bcas/ bsdus grwa tshigs bcad ma sogs dang*/ grub mtha'i rnam gzhag /'dul ba'i yig cha/ 'dul ba'i bslab bya rgyas tsam/ mdzod kyi ṭīkka rgyas pa dang*/ de'i don bsdus pa/ sdom gsum gyi bslab bya tshigs bcad dang tshigs lhugs su byas pa gnyis/ dbu ma'i lta khrid cung zad rgyas pa/ mtshan brjod ṭīkka/ bla ma mchod pa'i ṭīkka/ rten 'brel bstod pa'i ṭīkka/ tshangs cod ma'i ṭīkka/ bstod sprin rgya mtsho'i ṭīkka/ 'chi med grub pa'i ṭīkka/ skabs gsum ma'i ṭīkka/ thog tha bar dge'i ṭīkka/ rten 'grel snying po'i ṭīkka/ dmigs brtse ma'i ṭīkka/ 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying po'i ṭīkka/ gang blo ma'i ṭīkka/ blo chen mes po'i ṭīkka/ bar do'i 'phrang sgrol gyi ṭīkka/ lam rim bsdus don gyi ṭīkka/ sher snying ṭīkka/ 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud kyi ṭīkka/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi ṭīkka/ dus gsum rgyal ba ma'i 'grel pa/ sum rtags 'grel pa/ bshes springs mchan 'grel/ bo bstod 'grel pa/ yig brgya'i ṭīkka dang sgrol ṭīkka/ bla ma sna tshogs kyi gsol 'debs/ lam rim brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ yang lam rim brgyud pa dang dgon 'di'i bla brgyud kyi gsol 'debs/ bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i brtan bzhugs gsol 'debs/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems sogs kyi gsol 'debs rgyas bsdus gsum/ slob dpon bzang po rgyal mtshan dang slob dpon blo bzang sbyin pa dang slob dpon blo gros rgya mtsho slob dpon blo bzang dar rgyas rnams kyi gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs/ do lo nor bla ma dang bhi lig thu no mo hang gnyis kyi brtan bzhugs/ rje btsun mi la dang rgyal sras zhi ba lha'i gsol 'debs bstod pa/ 'jam dbyangs dmar ser/ 'jam dbyangs dkar po/ spyan ras gzigs/ byams pa/ phyag rdor/

rnam rgyal/ dbyas can ma/ mi g.yo ba rnams so so'i bstod pa/ mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing bkod/ smon lam/ 'pho ba/ mngon rtogs bum bskyed dkyil chog sa chog dang bcas pa/ rnam rgyal sa chog /kun rig chog bsgrigs ma/ de'i tshogs zhing*/ tshe dpag chog bsgrigs ma/ bde mchog chog bsgrigs ma/ rje'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel ba'i lta khrid tshigs bcad ma/ mgon chos so so'i gtor 'bul dang*/ chos skyong spyi'i gtor 'bul gnyis/ ming gi rnam grangs/ bsngo ba byed tshul rgyas bsdus gsum sogs dang*/ sangs rgyas byang sems du ma'i mtshan bsgrigs dang*/ sangs rgyas stong gi mtshan bsgrigs/ rten 'brel gyi rnam gzhag /dkor spyod yan lag bdun pa byed tshul/ bde mchog lha lnga dang 'jigs byed dpa' gcig bde mchog lhan skyes dang bcu gsum ma/ /'dus pa'i mdun bskyed kyi lhan thabs/ ka kha tshigs bcad ma tshar gnyis/ thos pa la bskul ba/ kun rig gi lhan thabs/ de'i sngags don dang phyag rgya'i skor/ de'i bum bskyed bsdus pa/ smyung gnas chog /ril sgrub cho ga /dmigs brtse ma'i ril sgrub/ tshe sgrub rgyas bsdus gnyis/ bcu gcig zhal gyi bla brgyud gsol 'debs smon lam shis brjod/ 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i mngon rtogs tshigs bcad ma/ tshe dpag dang 'jigs byed la brten pa'i lho sgo byed tshul/ 'jam dbyangs dkar po dang dmar ser gyi mngon rtogs cung zad rgyas pa/ ngag byin rlabs/ kun rig gi dbang po'i sbyor ba byed tshul/ yi dam sna tshogs pa'i sgrub skor/ sngags kyi klog tshul rgyas bsdus gnyis/ dag yig rgyas bsdus gnyis/ snyan ngag gi dper brjod cung rgyas pa/ yang snyan ngag mngon brjod brda rnying gsum gyi rnam gzhag /lam rim sogs nas 'byung ba'i don tshigs bcad du byas pa/ mnga' 'jug gi mdo'i don bsdus pa/ mdo sde mang po nas btus pa'i bslab bya tshigs bcad ma/ las kyi sgrib pa rnam par dag pa'i mdo'i don bsdus pa/

mi 'khrugs rnam rgyal rnam snang gsum gyi sgo nas skra chog byed tshul bla ma dang 'od dpag med byams pa gsum gyi 'pho ba/ don bdun cu'i rnam gzhag 'phros dang bcas pa/ skyabs 'gro'i khrid dang stobs bzhi'i bshags pa byed tshul/ 'byung bzhi dang brgya rtsa bsdus pa/ sātstsha gdab tshul/ sngags rim gyi snying po bsdus pa/ rdor sems bum sgrub/ yum gyi bgres rkang gi don bshad pa/ rgyud bla'i don rdo rje'i gnas bdun bshad pa/ rgyu dang 'bras bu rnam gzhag /'dus pa'i bla brgyud dang bdag mdun bde gsang gnyis kyi bsdus don dang 'chad tshul/ 'dus pa'i bsdus don rgyas par phye ba/ 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud kyi gleng gzhi'i yi ge bzhi bcu'i bshad pa zur du bstan pa/ 'dus pa'i bskyed rdzogs gnyis/ bde mchog bskyed rdzogs gnyis/ 'jigs byed bskyed rdzogs gnyis/ 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i bskyed rdzogs/ bde mchog lha lnga'i bskyed rdzogs/ bde gsang gnyis 'don tshul rgyas bsdus kyi dbye ba shes byed/ dkon mchog gsum gyi rnam gzhag /seṅge'i sgra dang phyag rdor la brten pa'i gdon 'gro bya tshul/ seṅge'i sgra'i mngon rtogs zur ba/ klu'i gdon 'grol/ tshe dbang bskur tshul/ grub mtha' la phyogs 'dzin gyi chags sdang 'gog pa'i yig cha/ snod bcud kyi rnam gzhag /'tshams sbyor lnga pa/ sdom pa'i skor gyi dogs gcod/ nyams len spyi'i dogs gcod/ 'jigs byed/ rab gnas/ sbyin sreg /zor las/ bde mchog mngon dkyil bum bskyed lag mchod bla brgyud bstod pa smon lam shis brjod kyi skor bsgrigs ma/ lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum gyi don 'grel lta khrid dang bcas pa/ bde ba can gyi zhing bkod smon lam dang bcas pa/ sbyong rgyud dang rtog bdun gnyis kyi bsdus don/ lam rim gyi khrid dmigs rgyas bsdus gnyis/ bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa len tshul/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'ga' zhig

/sman bla'i mdo nas 'byung ba'i smon lam zur du byas nas 'don tshul/ sman bla bsdus pa'i lhan thabs/ dus chen gyi bshad pa/ 'jam dbyangs nang gsang gnyis kyi sgrub thabs/ gzungs gzhug rab gnas bsdus pa/ 'jigs byed gtso bor byas pa'i bsnyen yig /'jigs byed gtor 'bul/ sa lam rnam gzhag /bum gter dang lto 'phye brtag tshul/ nag rtsis zhe bdun ma dang bcu gsum ma'i skor/ skar rtsis thor bu/ gsang bde 'jigs gsum gyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor rgyas pa/ bden bzhi dang rten 'brel gyi rnam gzhag /byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa'i tshul/ grub mtha' bzhi dang 'brel ba'i lta ba'i rnam gzhag rgyas tsam/ lta ba dang dus gsum gyi rnam gzhag zab mo/ bslab gsum sogs kyi khyad par bshad pa/ dgon 'di bla brgyud kyi rnam thar dkar chags/ dgon 'di'i rten thams cad kyi dkar chags/ dus tshigs kyi rnam gzhag /bden gnyis rnam gzhag /las dkar nag gi rnam gzhag / 'khor ba'i 'jug rim/ yum gyi mdo nas 'byung ba'i brgal lan/ 'khor lo chen po'i bla brgyud bstod pa smon lam shis brjod/ seng gdong ma'i mngon rtogs bskang gso sbyin bsreg mdos zor bcas pa/ yig bskur rnam gzhag tshar gnyis/ gshin rje 'char ka'i mngon rtogs mdos kyi rim pa/ snang brgyad kyi cho ga /nor lha la brten nas g.yang len tshul/ skar yig bsgrigs ma/ bsangs yig gi skor/ bca' yig /mar me 'bul tshul/ char 'bebs byed tshul/ gzhan dka' 'gyur dang*/ rje'i gsung 'bum dang*/ gra khang dang*/ jo bo'i lha khang sogs dkar chags kyi skor shin tu mang zhing*/ 'dir blo rigs rgyas tsam dang*/ bsdus dpe zur ba zhig dang*/ dbus na yod dus byams gzhung*/ skabs bzhi pa/ 'dul ba'i dus tshigs dang gso sbyong gi bshad pa bsgrigs ma sogs dang*/ gzhan ban bon 'ga' zhig gis nan cher bskul ba'i ngo bor de dag gi 'dod pa ltar lha gzhan dang gzhan gyi mngon rtogs sogs 'ga' zhig cung mi mngon pa'i tshul gyis bsgrigs byin pa yang yod de/

rma khar phan na khyi tshil gyi dpe ltar yin gyi/ rtsom tshad rang gis byed dgos pa'i nges pa med kyang klan ka 'ong bar dogs nas 'dir ma brjod/ der ma zad brtsams nas byin te gang yin brjed song ba dang*/ thar thor 'ga' zhig ni ma bris so/ /de yan ni re gnyis ma gtogs/ rang gis rtsom 'dod lhag dang bcas pa grub zin no/ /de dag ni rang lo re gnyis thog yan chad du yin la/ da dung kyang rang 'dod dang gzhan dbang gis 'bri ba'ang srid par 'gyur ro/ /mdor na rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa ci ltar bstan pa ni de'i rnam thar yin la/ de gsum gyi nang nas gsung gi mdzad pa ni rnam thar gyi mchog yin te/ ji skad du/ mdzad pa kun las gsung gi ni/ /mdzad pa mchog yin zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /des na sngon byon dam pa rnams kyi gsung gi mdzad pa ni de dag gi rnam thar gyi mchog yin pas/ kho bo cag gi rnam thar gyi khul yang rtsom pa byas pa 'di rnams gtso bo lags so/ /gzhan tshe 'di'i bya byed dran tshad thams cad bris na po ti chen por 'gyur zhing dgos pa mi snang la/ 'ga' zhig gi rnam thar du de dus kyi rgyal po dang dus kyi 'gyur ba ji lta bu dang rang la 'bul ba ji ltar byung ba rnams bris 'dug pa ltar byas kyang dgos don chung bas bzhag go /dgos pa'i don dpe rtsom tshul de ltar yin na nyams len ji ltar byas snyam na/ bla ma grong chog pa la nyams len bzang po yod dka' yang cung zad brjod par bya ste/ spyir sngon gyi skyes chen dam pa rnams kyi nyams len dang snying rus lta bu ni da lta'i gang zag la yod dka' la/ 'on kyang rang nyid brtson 'grus bzang bar rlom yang da lta thos nyung blun po 'ga' zhig gis brtson 'grus byed pa mthong na/ kho bo cag ni brtson 'grus che bar mi sems so/ /de lta na'ang gzhan nam rang don du grong chog byed pa 'di re zhig spong mi nus pa tsam ma gtogs/

rgyun du kha ton byed pa'am/ dpe klog pa'am/ rtsom pa byed pa gsum po gang rung min pa'i don med pa'i g.yeng ba dang don med du bsdad pa cher ma byas shing*/ bsnyen 'tshams 'ga' re dang*/ kha ton kyang bcad rgya byas nas gsang bde 'jigs gsum sogs dang*/ de'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang*/ lha gzhan 'ga' zhig gi rnal 'byor dang*/ bde gsang gi rgyud dang*/ sdud pa dang mtshan brjod sogs 'don pa dang*/ gzungs sngags mang po dang*/ sangs rgyas byang sems mang po'i mtshan brjod pa'i gsol 'debs dang*/ lam rim gyi snying po byams snying rje lhag bsam sems bskyed lta ba sems la nyin re bzhin ci nus su 'bad khul byas pa ste/ 'dir de tsam las zhib par ma brjod do/ /smras pa/ bzang bzang rgyal ba'i mdo sngags dam pa'i chos/ /nges nges 'dzin pa'i ched du sngon byon pa'i/ /mkhas mkhas dam pa'i bshes gnyen thams cad la/ /dung dung gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /skye zhing skye ba brgyud pa mi dran yang*/ /sngon tshe sngon gyi rgyal ba'i chos tshul rgyun/ /'di ru 'di ltar 'dzin pa'i smon lam 'bras/ /gang zhig gang la 'di bzhin smin pa mtshar/ /de yang yul dus sbyin bdag mthun rkyen sogs/ /rten 'brel bzang po du ma lhan cig tu/ /tshogs las 'byung gi rgyu dang rkyen gcig gis/ /'bras bu phun tshogs 'di ltar ga la bskrun/ /bser bus bskyod tshe shing bal 'dab bzang la/ /'gran pa bzhin 'gro dam pa'i rlung shugs kyis/ /bskul bas byi'u'i rnam thar mkha' lding gi /ngang tshul bzhin du ston pa 'di na mthong*/ /rab dkar zla 'dra'i shog ngos su/ /rab rmongs byis pa'i spyod tshul 'ga'/ /rab mdzes ri bong mtshan ma ltar/ /rab rib mig can dag la snang*/ /'on te mdo rgyud du ma las/ /rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma yi/ /yon tan mdzad spyod dman na'ang*/ /bsngags brjod byas kyang phan yon ni/ /chen po 'byung bar gsungs phyir 'dir/

/rang la lung rtogs yon tan tshogs/ khyad 'phags min yang slob ma yis/ /chen por bsngags brjod bzung mi 'gal/ /tshul de gzigs nas ko'u shrai nang so yis/ kha btags maṇḍal gser dngul gos yug gi /'bul byas rgyud pa'i tshogs dang lhan cig tu/ /bskul las bshad sgrub ming can bdag nyid kyis/ /rang lo bcu phrag drug dang gnyis son thog /rgyud pa'i slob dpon byed tshe g.yar khral lam/ /gzhan ngo tsam phyir sgro skur med pa ru/ /ji ltar 'tsham pa nyid du legs par sbyar/ /zhes bya'o/ /slob dpon bshad sgrub mtshan can gyi rnam thar 'di ni/ rje btsun byang chub mi la rin po che'i dpon po dge slong ngag dbang bkra shis zhes bya ba rgyud grwar zhugs nas sngags ram pa'i mtshan gdags mdzad zin pa'i tshe 'di snyam du rang la kha dog bzo lta chen po med kyang sngags phyogs la thos bsam cung zad byed rgyu byung ba dang*/ dka' rab 'byams kyi grwal du tshud tsam byung ba 'di yang slob dpon rin po che 'di dang ko'u shris yes rnam gnyis kyi thugs rje kho na yin snyam pa'i dad pa kho nas drin bzo ba'i ched du dpon slob nyid kyi rnam thar 'di par du bsgrubs pa'i dge bas rgyud pa'i 'chad nyan gyi bstan pa dar ba dang*/ par du bskrun pa po nyid tshe rabs thams cad du sngags sgrub pa'i rten bzang po rim par brgyud nas myur du rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob par gyur cig /par gyi yi ge pa ni dge slong blo bzang phun tshogs so/ /bkra shis// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/slob dpon bshad sgrub mtshan can gyi rnam thar rgyu skar rnam par rtsen pa bzhugs/ -PAGE 132--PAGE 133--PAGE 104-
